name: Burnley Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at St Cuthbert's Church. Open Mon 10am-2pm for distribution. Referral required via local agencies including Citizens Advice.

name: Burnley Borough Allotments
short_description: Council and private allotment sites across Burnley
description: Burnley Council manages sites including Healey Wood
image: and Barden Lane. Also private sites at Fulledge and Stoops. Plots from £30/year. Waiting lists available.

name: Hameldon Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden on the slopes of Hameldon Hill. Grows heritage varieties and provides seasonal produce for local residents. Open weekends during growing season.
